description: This file defines the OrderAttributeType class, an extension of the BaseAttributeType class, representing attribute types associated with orders within the OpenMRS framework. It includes ID management and annotations for auditing.

classes.name: OrderAttributeType
classes.description: An extension of BaseAttributeType representing attribute types linked to orders, with ID management and auditing support.
